verdict: Leads dropped sharply this week; the root causes are identified and being addressed.
narrative: Over the last 28 days you received 8 leads at a cost of $230 per lead — and in the most recent 7 days, lead volume fell 50% while cost per lead roughly doubled compared to the prior 7 days. Two things are driving this: Google Ads spend climbed 14% without a matching lift in conversions, and your "Quality HVAC by Fibid" Google Business Profile nearly stopped generating inbound calls, dropping to just 2 calls over the full 28-day window. We are pausing erratic Google Ads spend patterns and prioritizing the Business Profile optimization to rebuild that free inbound channel before the heating season campaigns go live October 1. Several setup milestones that were scheduled for July–September are also being closed out now, including intake confirmation and the LSA heating toggle, because those open items are limiting how far we can responsibly scale.
